description: Réseau urbain & scolaire - Lila Presqu'île (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Cap Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transdev CapAtlantique Mobilités - Lila Presqu'ile. Le réseau de transport Lila Presqu'île ouvre les données des lignes régulières et scolaires de son service de transport en commun. Les données sont mises à jour périodiquement lors de changements de l’offre de transport. Coverage: Cap Atlantique (Loire-Atlantique). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport, bus. The portal shows 1,876 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-capatlantique-fr-portal.
